title: Sorceress and Demon Horde
description: A woman in a black futuristic bodysuit with glowing white lines stands centered in a dark industrial chamber, arms outstretched. She is surrounded by multiple floating demonic figures: four red female demons with long white hair wielding glowing red energy rings, four black horned demonic heads with red eyes, and numerous smaller pinkish-purple hanging devil-like creatures suspended from an overhead metal rail system.
prompt: A woman in a sleek black bodysuit with glowing white circuitry lines stands powerfully in the center of a dark futuristic industrial room with metal walkways, arms outstretched controlling magic. She is surrounded by levitating demonic entities: four tall red female demons with long flowing white hair casting glowing red circular energy spells, several large black horned demonic heads with glowing red eyes, and many smaller pink devilish creatures hanging from overhead metal tracks like meat hooks, dramatic volumetric lighting, cinematic composition.
